errors.evidence: The y-axis label in the figure is “发文章量” (vertical text), not “发文量/篇”.

In the legend, 南开大学 is shown with a mustard/gold square, which is not clearly the same as the separate brown color used for 四川大学; calling it “棕黄” misassigns the visible color mapping.
